description: Tasks are Markdown files. Their body are the description. Their YAML frontmatter contains their metadata. This is the schema for those frontmatters.

priority.description: Used to decide which task to tackle first after dependencies are solved. Urgent (0), High (1), Medium (2), or Low (4).

depends_on.description: Other tasks that need to be completed before this one can be started.

acceptance_criteria.description: Concrete ways to determine the task is done. Draft tasks may omit this field, but promoted tasks must provide a non-empty list.

items.description: Concrete ways to determine the task is done.
